name: mslearn-video-documenter
description: Analyzes screen recordings and generates MS Learn-style documentation

chatParticipants.name: video-documenter
chatParticipants.description: Analyzes screen recordings and generates MS Learn documentation

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Plan documentation: select video, collect metadata, analyze, and optionally generate

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a screen recording video (with option to auto-generate)

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Edit a section of generated documentation

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save generated document to a specific location

commands.name: polish
commands.description: Run quality checks: style, branding, metadata, SEO, formatting, security

video-documenter.backendUrl.description: URL of the Video Documenter backend server

video-documenter.outputDirectory.description: Workspace-relative directory for generated documentation output

video-documenter.autoOpenPreview.description: Automatically open markdown preview after generating a document

video-documenter.useCopilotModels.description: Use GitHub Copilot models for document generation in local mode (requires active Copilot subscription)

video-documenter.lmProxyPort.description: Port for the LM Proxy server (0 = auto-assign). The proxy exposes Copilot models as an OpenAI-compatible API for the backend.

video-documenter.autoStartBackend.description: Automatically start the Python backend server when the extension activates. Disable if you prefer to start the backend manually.

video-documenter.backendPath.description: Path to the backend directory. Leave empty to auto-detect from the monorepo layout (backend/ next to vscode-extension/).

video-documenter.author.description: Default GitHub username for the document author (pre-fills in /plan)

video-documenter.msAuthor.description: Default Microsoft alias for ms.author (pre-fills in /plan)

video-documenter.processingMode.description: Processing mode: 'local' uses FFmpeg + Whisper, 'cloud' uses Azure Video Indexer + AI Speech
enumDescriptions: Local processing using FFmpeg, PySceneDetect, and OpenAI Whisper
Cloud processing using Azure Video Indexer and Azure AI Speech

video-documenter.foundryProjectEndpoint.description: Azure AI Foundry project endpoint (cloud mode only). Example: https://your-project.services.ai.azure.com

video-documenter.foundryModel.description: Azure AI Foundry model deployment name (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.foundryModelMini.description: Azure AI Foundry smaller model for simpler tasks (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.blobAccountUrl.description: Azure Blob Storage account URL (cloud mode only). Example: https://stvideodocumenter.blob.core.windows.net

video-documenter.blobContainerName.description: Azure Blob Storage container name (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.speechServiceEndpoint.description: Azure AI Speech endpoint URL (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.speechServiceRegion.description: Azure AI Speech region (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.videoIndexerAccountId.description: Azure Video Indexer account ID (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.videoIndexerResourceId.description: Full ARM resource ID for Azure Video Indexer (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.videoIndexerLocation.description: Azure Video Indexer account location (cloud mode only)

video-documenter.whisperModel.description: OpenAI Whisper model size for transcription (local mode only)

video-documenter.ffmpegPath.description: Path to FFmpeg binary (local mode only). Default uses PATH lookup.

video-documenter.progressUpdateIntervalS.description: Minimum interval (in seconds) between progress updates shown in chat during video processing
